newsitem.title: FRANCE: Andersen Consulting launches ad campaign in France.
newsitem.headline: Andersen Consulting launches ad campaign in France.

text.p: Management consultant Andersen Consulting said on Monday it was running its third television advertising campaign in France from March 1 to March 23, with agency Young & Rubicam again handling the campaign.

It said in a statement that the third spot, based on linking the various art forms found in a museum with the various sorts of expertise found at Andersen, would be broadcast on terrestrial TV channels TF1, France 2, France 3 and M6 and on cable news channel LCI.
The campaign's budget is about eight million francs ($5.4 million), an Andersen spokeswoman said.
Andersen said it had broken new ground in 1995 when it became the first management consultant to use television advertising, and had followed up with a second campaign in March 1996.
This time the third spot will be broadcast together with the two previous ones, which were also handled by Young & Rubicam.
There will also be a poster campaign in airports and the spot will be shown on Air France long courrier flights. ($ = 1.479 Swiss Francs)
